name: @pipeworx/mcp-federal-civil

tools.name: federal_civil_search
tools.description: Find US FEDERAL CIVIL LAWSUITS by party name. Searches federal district court civil dockets, no API key — contract disputes, civil rights, employment, product liability, ERISA, social security appeals and prisoner petitions. Returns case caption, docket number, district, filing and termination dates, assigned judge, and the nature-of-suit code where the court recorded one. Use for "is this company being sued in federal court" and litigation exposure checks. A party search also runs a live, token-less CourtListener search for anything filed after the snapshot_date the bulk data carries and merges it in, so a suit filed last week is found; those rows are marked coverage:"live" and carry the full party list, which catches a derivative suit captioned against officers rather than the company. A case REMOVED from state court carries a removed_from object giving the originating state court and its state docket number, so the state and federal records can be linked — a removal is otherwise invisible on a federal docket, whose cause code describes the federal statute invoked rather than where the case came from.

party.description: Party name or a distinctive part of it, e.g. "Monsanto".

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

filed_before.description: Only cases filed on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

check_removal.description: Look up which state court each case was removed from (default true). Set false to skip one upstream request per call when you do not need it.

tools.name: federal_civil_recent
tools.description: List recent US federal civil lawsuits, newest first, optionally limited to one district. No API key. A case removed from state court carries a removed_from object naming the originating state court and its state docket number.

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

check_removal.description: Look up which state court each case was removed from (default true). Set false to skip one upstream request per call when you do not need it.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-federal-civil forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the federal-civil pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
